create_FisherSnedecor: create a Fisher-Snedecor distribution with df1 and df2 degrees of freedom parameters
test_FisherSnedecor_rsample: test the FisherSnedecor distribution rsample method to generate reparameterized random samples
test_FisherSnedecor_log_prob: test the FisherSnedecor distribution log_prob method to compute log probability of values
test_FisherSnedecor_mean: test the FisherSnedecor distribution mean property to compute expected value
test_FisherSnedecor_variance: test the FisherSnedecor distribution variance property to compute variance
